title: Delivery Claims Recovery Desk: Wrong-Item Keep Charge Calculation
content:
Recovery desk calculation of the charge for a wrong item that a customer keeps under an approved Delivery Claims Wrong Item Claim.

**Calculation.** The wrong-item keep charge is the merchandise compensation booked on the claim for the line the wrong item came in place of (its merchandise refund entries, tax share included), for the units compensated on that line, all of which the customer keeps, rounded to the nearest cent on the final figure. A wrong item the customer keeps carries back the share of the delivery-charge refund on its claim that its line makes up of the claim's merchandise compensation; Goodwill Credit is never recovered.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| the line the wrong item came in place of | the order line recorded on the claim's wrong item photo evidence (the most recent such entry) |
| merchandise compensation for the line, units compensated | the claim's merchandise refund entries on that line: their amounts with tax share, and their units |
| the claim's merchandise compensation | all of the claim's merchandise refund entries, every line |
| delivery-charge refund on the claim | the claim's shipping fee refund entries |

The keep base is the merchandise compensation for the line. The carried-back share is the delivery-charge refund on the claim, multiplied by the line's merchandise compensation and divided by the claim's merchandise compensation; with no merchandise compensation on the claim, nothing is carried back.

## How the charge is assembled

Where rates apply to the keep charge, they are added together into one rate, applied once to the keep base. Any keep label saving is then taken off. The carried-back share of the delivery-charge refund is then added. The charge is never below 0.00 and is rounded to the nearest cent on the final figure.

## Worked figure (hypothetical claim)

Merchandise refund entries of 60.00 USD on the line (2 units) and 60.00 USD on another line, so 120.00 USD on the claim; a shipping fee refund entry of 10.00 USD. The line makes up half of the claim's merchandise compensation, so 5.00 USD of the delivery-charge refund is carried back, and the keep charge is 60.00 plus 5.00, that is 65.00 USD. A Goodwill Credit on the claim would not enter the charge.
